d: Skate with Lane Hutson as a 360 camera mounted to his stick captures a one-of-a-kind POV during practice at the 2026 NHL Heritage Classic. From a view you’ve never seen before, go from the locker room to the outdoor rink with the Montreal Canadiens defenseman. Ride along for a few laps with the shifty, puck-moving defenseman at Princess Auto Stadium in Winnipeg as the Canadiens get ready to face the Winnipeg Jets.
